All 13 generic controls render as Calcite components, including typed number inputs, radio groups with child-owned selection, slotted notices, and progress normalized to Calcite’s 0–100 range. Use design="native" with serve to opt out, or set a control’s Calcite-specific properties with control.for_design("calcite", ...).
